title: M/s Bhawani Roller Flour Mills Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J.; Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following connected 4.20 additional-security batch.
headnote: A challenge to additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was tagged with the Vehina Steels batch. Interim restraint on the demand followed that batch; the writ was later dismissed by reference to the same-date order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
facts: M/s Bhawani Roller Flour Mills Ltd. challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was tagged with Vehina Steels (W.P. 30582 of 2009) and like petitions. On 3 July 2013, following that batch's interim, the Court restrained the demand until further orders. On 21 March 2017 the writ was dismissed by reference to the same-date order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was connected with W.P. No. 30582 of 2009 (Vehina Steels) and similar matters; following that interim, the respondents were restrained from demanding additional security until further orders, without prejudice. On 21 March 2017 the Division Bench dismissed the writ, directing that the order of that date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 be seen.
